acceptanceCriteria: A frozen replay of this task (or an equivalent spec-routed implementation task) carries cmd/corvint/affected.go, tools/gate-affected-select and the Makefile, or the packet names each as withheld with its reason.
The change passes the existing context evaluation gates with no regression on the frozen held-out set.
body: Observed 2026-10-11 by the V1-0040 slice-1 lane. Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 407), `corvint context --task` (201-char task, limit 25) at tree fab866738 (base 136dfa483). The task was to implement the Session Test Runner (`corvint test`, docs/specs/session-test-runner-v0.md). Expected: the packet carries the code the change necessarily edits or reuses: cmd/corvint/affected.go (compileAffectedGraph, shared with the new verb), tools/gate-affected-select (AFP-V0-012 attribution, moved into internal/gateselect) and the Makefile go-test recipe (STR-V0-006 typing). Actual: 25 results dominated by lexical rows (ci.yml, ci-test-slices, cishards, conformance/cli-parity-v0/manifest.go, a CEM sidecar, a benchmark run JSON). None of the three files was included, and 6184 code rows were withheld by the result limit. Answerability was `no-specific-terms`, so the packet did signal weak grounding. This is a suspected recall gap for spec-routed implementation tasks, not a confirmed bug. Evidence: scratchpad context.txt of session 23782259 (not retained in the repository).
title: context: STR slice-1 packet missed the affected command, gate-affected-select and the Makefile that the change had to edit
